user_authorization.meaning: User explicitly authorizes retaining the actual account equity as already-earned opening surplus and switching the strategy without withdrawing the difference or forcibly flattening the existing position.
does_not_imply: historical weekly19 trading PnL has been verified
an unknown stop/entry date/cost/high-water mark is known
existing position may be represented by only pos_data
a synthetic opening fill may be invented

current_m3_gates.cash_observation: currently requires real initial balance150000 and no prior funding activity

feasible_routes.verdict: Preferred when evidence exists; old C9 settings/release are never silently made weekly19-compatible.

feasible_routes.verdict: Technically feasible under the current authorization, but requires a new reviewed startup policy/material. It cannot claim historical protection continuity or m3 already passed.

feasible_routes.verdict: Reject; existing downstream reconciliation and close-identity contracts correctly fail closed.

requirements: Principal remains150000; external reserve starts150000; confirmed new topups T0=0.

Pin E0 from the actual source-qualified account, Available and gross Deposit/Withdraw as a checkpoint. Opening surplus S0=E0-150000 is separately labeled opening carried equity, not verified strategy history or a transfer.
For t after cutover: post_cutover_net_pnl=Et-E0-new_Tcum; Et=150000+S0+post_cutover_net_pnl+new_Tcum; Rt=150000-new_Tcum.
Sizing must use actual broker E and Available and include margin/heat from the adopted holding. Do not set E0 to150000, add S0 twice, or make reserve available inside the account.
Actual broker cash remains authoritative; later manual cash reviews preserve existing request/receipt/account/release/day/duplicate guards.
Same source-bound actual account, symbol/epoch, direction, lots/yd/today split, frozen quantity and no unresolved external order ownership; no synthetic trade or broker-order identifiers.

ProductState contract/direction/layers, strategy.pos_data and target_data, confirmed entry_price_synced quantities and runtime.position_identities must all exactly agree with actual physical holdings.
One append-only adoption identity binds account/material/cohort/snapshot rawSHA/physical epoch and actual quantity; risk_close/rollover_close must have a confirmed root/cycle/position identity.
Runtime close_lifecycles must retain actual lots/remaining and preserve real fill/retry/idempotency after adoption. New adoption is not a pending or executed native_entry.
Daily-addon is disabled in this C branch; _da_inventory/_da_close_queue from the enabled sleeve are not required or consumed.
Prefer source-verified complete compatible old protection/cost state through an explicit migration mapper; never directly relabel an old C9 runtime with the new release/settings hash.

If compatible old strategy history is unavailable, explicitly version a fresh adoption baseline, including basis date, PnL attribution, initial stop rule, highest/lowest/max_profit_pct, prev2week age/ratchet and portfolio high-water/reset policy. Label unknown pre-cutover history rather than inventing it.

Stage174 generic position.price is intentionally0; native PositionCost is not OpenCost. OpenCost can at most support a verified aggregate cost calculation with correct multiplier/lot convention; it cannot establish actual entry date/stop/high-water path. Native position detail fields OpenDate/TradeID/OpenPrice are not in the existing four-query capture.
Derive protection only from approved completed physical-epoch weekly bars and a declared deterministic rule; no forming bars, retrospective optimized window, or synthetic historical on_bars/fills.

Changing entry_date to cutover changes prev2week activation: it counts two complete post-entry weeks. Zeroing high-water/max-profit/prev2week ratchet may loosen protection; disclose and review the explicit migration semantics.

Existing real entry-cost lifecycle PnL may include pre-cutover holding PnL. Keep lifetime trade outcome distinct from Et-E0-newT; broker cash must never be incremented by reconstructed historical PnL.

Do not remove m3 normal flat initial gate or use a fake flat broker snapshot to get through the constructor. Add a narrow immutable startup mode/receipt that validates and installs complete adoption before strict reconcile.
If weekly history is needed to derive protection, warm actual completed AM data without historical decision replay before final reconciliation; actual snapshot is never modified.

Cash checkpoint, adoption receipt/position state, full runtime snapshot and source/data identity commit together through the existing single-actor PipelineStateStore CAS. No partial cash/runtime publication.

Replaying the same adoption is idempotent; changed account/release/quantity/source snapshot or re-adopting after trading activity is rejected. Crash recovery validates the committed adoption, not a fresh invented baseline.
Coordinate exclusive account ownership and retire old pending intent/executor authority before enabling the new one; preserve prior evidence/history, do not replay old C9 drafts.

A new migration version changes m3 startup semantics and requires fresh material/source binding, offline adversarial review and the existing real production qualification/manifest/activation/runtime/data-readiness gates. User authorization does not replace any technical gate.

Keep the real qualified capture authority, exact stable/source/material identity and fresh account/positions/orders/fills/quote/session/physical-child execution gates. No reuse of unqualified direct diagnostic as production authority.
Do not revive the canceled automatic bank producer/final settlement parser work. operator_manual_v1 remains the authorized cash mode.
No new native connection, financial replay, order/cancel, SMTP or production action is performed by this review.

unknowns: Whether a complete compatible prior owner state exists is assigned to the other evidence reviewer and was not inspected by this review.
Actual original entry date/price/cost conventions and prior stop/highest/lowest/max_profit/prev2week ratchet remain unproven from the four-query aggregate snapshot alone.
Whether to migrate proven old state or declare a new protection/age/high-water reset must be fixed in Stage024 contract before implementation; user need not repeat general risk authorization.
New exact cutover timestamp/cold-start cursor, latest approved completed physical bars, old pending authority and exclusivity must be bound to the real adoption receipt.
